ValidationRule.description: This rule restricts the user to populate the Rating before selecting the case issue status as closed . Added as a part of STY-01562
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND (
$Setup.NSP_Trigger_Switch__c.CaseIssueValidation__c != true, ISPICKVAL( NSP_Status__c , 'Closed'), ISBLANK( TEXT(NSP_Rating__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Update Quick Rate in order to close the Case Issue.
